title: Systematic physicochemical characterization, carbon balance and cost of production analyses of activated carbons derived from (Co)-HTC of coal discards and sewage sludge for hydrogen storage applications
material_description: AC-HCT | activated carbon: KOH-activated hydrochar of South African coal tailing (CT, Mpumalanga coal beneficiation plant); HTC 150 °C, 27 bar, 95 min (Table 10), then KOH/HC 4:1; ash 40.86 wt%, C 51.16 wt% (Table 6)
purification_method: washed with 0.5 N HCl, then distilled water (centrifuge) to pH about 6; dried at 60 °C for 24 h

source_location: main.pdf p.17 (journal p.141), Fig. 8a (77 K, cm3/g vs MPa), series AC-HCT ads; wt% from Fig. 9a (same marker, B's digitization)
notes: archive: fig8a_AC-HCT_ads.json; no wt% digitized: the Fig 9a marker of this point is partly hidden by another marker; uptake_wt_pct is W1 computed from cm3(STP)/g (0.0089938 x 116.350); Fig 9a plots this run on a wt% scale about 3.3x larger; pressure = 0.4411 MPa x 10; marker partly overlapped by another series (pixel_count 23 vs typical 41).
